prompts.authority_limits: Diagnoses failed criteria; does not redo whole-case research.
required_analysis: Classify mandate, research, calculation, evidence, human-only or fatal gap
Identify exact return target and closure test
evidence_rules: Diagnosis cites failed criterion and affected claim/calculation
counterevidence_rules: Do not label adverse evidence as merely missing evidence
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent a repair path or mark fatal mismatch researchable.
prompts.role_boundary: Diagnoses; Memory records and Controller decides.

prompts.authority_limits: Append-only case memory; cannot rewrite history.
required_analysis: Preserve gate history and prior attempts
output_contract: Updated case memory and iteration record
evidence_rules: Deduplicate by stable ID without deleting older records
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not silently alter prior evidence, calculations or gate outcomes.
prompts.role_boundary: Stores state; does not decide next action.

prompts.authority_limits: Chooses advance, targeted retry, alternate method, human review, stop or fatal termination within budgets.
output_contract: Controller decision and exact return target
evidence_rules: Advance only on allowed gate status
counterevidence_rules: Do not loop away a fatal mismatch or value destruction
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not broaden mandate or bypass failed criteria.
prompts.role_boundary: Controls execution; does not perform research or re-evaluate business merits.

prompts.authority_limits: Creates the smallest repair plan for the controller-selected stage.
required_analysis: State expected evidence and closure test
Return only to Block A, B or C target
evidence_rules: Repair plan must satisfy the module evidence contract
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not rewrite unaffected modules or predeclare success.
prompts.role_boundary: Plans a retry; Researcher or Calculation Engine executes it.
